name: NSE Strategy Lab
description: Rule-based NSE strategies tested on up to five years of saved daily history, adjusted for splits and bonuses, with costs, equity against a benchmark, every trade on a chart, and paper accounts that run strategies forward on new sessions. Simulation only; no orders reach a broker.
author: Vakyartha

nse__get_stock_history.reason: Save up to five years of each chosen stock’s daily sessions, and fill gaps after missed days.

nse__get_index_history.reason: Save the benchmark index, which is the trading calendar and the comparison for every backtest.

nse__get_bulk_quote.reason: Add the latest session for every stock in the universe in one read each day.

nse__get_corporate_actions.reason: Read splits and bonuses with NSE’s price factor, so earlier prices are adjusted.

tools.name: get_strategy_results
tools.title: Strategy results
tools.description: Saved backtest results of the user's NSE strategies: return, compound annual growth, worst fall, Sharpe, trades and win rate against the benchmark, with the data period. Historical simulation, not advice.

strategy.description: Optional strategy name or id; omitted returns every strategy.

tools.name: get_paper_accounts
tools.title: Paper accounts
tools.description: The user's paper trading accounts: equity, cash, open positions, next-session orders and closed trades. Simulated; no broker.

skills.name: strategy-lab-reader
skills.description: Read and explain the user's Strategy Lab backtests and paper accounts
